note: Assessment metadata for spelling inflection items, kept beside the items so no existing item record (or its review fingerprint) changes. Generated items are covered by rule in code (generated.base and template); every other inflection item must have an entry here. lemma = the base word; lexeme_family groups every form of one lemma; exposure_family is the item's own production family; polarity contrast = the rule must not be applied; uses = what the item is suitable or reserved for (one answer is still one piece of evidence); reserved = the lemma appears in no other spelling item and must stay unseen for transfer or delayed checks. Curated and authored entries need educator review.

spl.dx.ex.07@1.dialect_note: British doubles the final l (travelled); American does not (traveled). Both accepted until an educator decides.
